question: Does frozen SEL-S1 F4 Shallow Ground Arc materially improve persistent creator-selection legibility for the already-selected Wren in the exact PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 Stage while preserving the incumbent floor/name hinge, ensemble hierarchy and separation from Current Opportunity, Speaking, Take a Seat and unresolved arc/pip semantics?
single_variable: one additive persistent-selection witness raster beneath the existing Wren SELECTED label

incumbent_state.state_law: Wren is already selected in PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; selection leaves the cone materially unchanged and creates no fictional action. No new selection state is invented for this comparison.

source_translation.source_css: F4 selected hinge uses width 29.4% of the fixed hinge, height 14px, border-bottom:2px solid currentColor and lower 50% corner radii; this equals 42% of the frozen floor-pool width in the neutral scaffold.
source_translation.stage_translation_law: Translate only the ground-following witness proportion to the existing Wren floor/name hinge. Do not import neutral scaffold dimensions, beam/pool geometry, typography, focus ellipse or any other fixture styling.
source_translation.mask_predicate: For each integer pixel x=664..716 and y=490..498, compute q=((x-690)/26)^2+((y-490)/8)^2. Include the pixel iff 0.68<=q<=1.0.
source_translation.stroke_source_law: Use the exact frozen SEL-S1 harness currentColor (--ink:#f2f2ee) so the comparison changes witness geometry only; this comparison color is evidence scaffolding and creates no final palette/token authority.
source_translation.compositing: Opaque replace only the 106 mask pixels with stroke_rgb. No antialiasing, blur, glow, alpha blend, resampling or neighboring-pixel modification.

excluded_variables: Wren cone, floor pool, identity cue, name, SELECTED label and three pips
all other Character cones, pools, names, state labels, identity cues and pips
Current Opportunity, Speaking, Listening and Rest optics
Take a Seat, Perspective, creator actions and Intervene semantics
right rail, Observed Cues, inter-character arcs and unresolved pip/arc meaning
Production/Scene context, background causal field, shell, controls and footer
palette outside the frozen witness comparison color, typography, motion and implementation

must_be_exact: all 1,573,352 incumbent pixels except the 106 frozen witness-mask coordinates
Wren SELECTED text and the full three-pip row
Wren cone/pool/name/identity cue and existing selection treatment
every other Character and every non-Character Stage region
must_remain_semantically_unchanged: USER SELECTION != CURRENT OPPORTUNITY != SPEAKING != TAKE A SEAT
selection remains persistent creator focus only
the cone remains presence rather than a button/container
the floor/name relationship remains the interaction hinge
unresolved inter-character arc and three-pip semantics remain unresolved

required: input SHA-256, byte count and dimensions equal the frozen baseline
generated mask has exactly 106 unique pixels and bbox [664,490,716,498]
all 106 mask pixels differ from the incumbent stroke_rgb value before construction
exactly 106 pixels change and every changed coordinate belongs to the frozen mask
all non-mask pixels are byte-identical to the incumbent
Wren SELECTED text and all three pips remain byte-identical
challenger and comparison board receive immutable hashes before subjective scoring
an evidence-only Wren hinge crop confirms no clipping, accidental pip connection or raster defect before scoring
construction_preflight.technical_failure_law: Any hash, mask, pixel-isolation, clipping, collision or raster-integrity failure rejects the technical attempt before scoring. Repair may only conform implementation to this frozen method; no geometry, color, criterion or F4 variant may change.

evaluation_criteria: F4 must materially improve persistent selection legibility for the already-selected Wren over the exact incumbent.
The witness must remain local to the Wren floor/name hinge and must not turn the cone into a button, chip, card, avatar container or boxed selectable object.
The witness must remain clearly subordinate to Wren's presence, name, SELECTED label and existing identity cue rather than becoming the most authoritative mark.
The witness must not read as Current Opportunity, Speaking, validation, progress, navigation, nomination or another narrative/runtime state.
The witness must not read as Take a Seat, occupied-seat ownership or creator possession.
The witness must not visually fuse with the three pips or imply that the unresolved pips/inter-character arcs have acquired selection, progress or causality semantics.
The witness must preserve five-Character ensemble balance and must not increase competition with Performance text, Production/Scene context, creator controls or the right rail.
The additive witness must feel native to the incumbent floor/name hinge rather than like crop/edit/alignment tooling or an ornamental underline detached from the Character.
Promotion requires a material net improvement over PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; parity, mixed tradeoff or any new semantic ambiguity retains the incumbent.

decision_law.failure_consequence: Retain PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 and close the F4 comparison. Do not change arc geometry, witness color, placement or author F4b in this gate.
decision_law.promotion_consequence: Promote only the bounded persistent-selection witness integration. No final palette, focus-management, Take-a-Seat, pip/arc, motion, typography, implementation or ODR authority is created.

next_action: Commit and host-validate this preregistration. Only after both hosted checks pass, construct one deterministic challenger from the exact incumbent bytes using the 106-pixel mask, run the full construction-preservation audit, freeze challenger/comparison hashes and inspect the evidence-only hinge crop before any subjective criterion is scored.
